title: Retention and Physical-Volume Disk Protection, Critical Recording Safety and Recent Operations UX
summary: Completes Stage 13.5 / 4.10.2 with durable automatic retention and physical-volume-aware disk protection. Per-camera age or quota policies continue through bounded slices without artificial byte limits, while low-space protection keeps warning, auto-free, recovery and critical recording suspension thresholds distinct. Critical safety remains active when auto-free is disabled, and recording resumes only after the same suspended physical volume has measurably recovered. Recent archive operations now use the real backend contract and appear as bounded, localized, operator-safe history.
changelog: Adds durable automatic retention on top of the shared storage-operation, lease, fencing and conflict foundation.
Treats retention_days and storage_quota_gb as independent per-camera rules with OR execution and status semantics.
Continues logical retention runs through bounded slices without artificial file-count or byte-size pauses.
Groups archive roots by physical volume and preserves distinct warning, cleanup, recovery and critical thresholds.
Keeps automatic deletion disabled when auto-free is OFF while retaining independent critical recording protection.
Resumes low-disk-suspended recording only after the same physical volume is measured at 9 percent free or more.
Requires versioned server-side acknowledgement, actor identity, timestamp and audit evidence before first auto-free enablement.
Separates automatic slices, bounded manual/support retention and complete user-requested deletion policies.
Keeps recurring storage status read-only, bounded and free from hidden ORM writes or heavy archive work.
Maps durable recent operations into localized, sanitized names, statuses, useful outcomes and next actions.
Keeps Recent Operations secondary, collapsed by default and bounded to five compact desktop/mobile rows.
